task.title: Preserve colonless SSE field semantics
task.objective: Treat colonless event and data fields as fields carrying empty values
acceptance_criteria: A colonless data field contributes an empty data value and joining newline
A colonless event field resets the event name to the empty value

attempts.summary: Added deterministic regressions for colonless data and event fields
attempts.diagnostic: Both colonless field regressions failed because the parser ignored those lines

attempts.summary: Accepted exact colonless field names and reused existing empty-value handling

outcome.summary: Colonless SSE fields now preserve grammar-defined empty values and multiline joining behavior

verification.command: GitHub Rust quality gate for PR 1082

lessons: A missing separator can denote an empty protocol value rather than an unknown or malformed line
Reuse one field-value path for colonless and explicit-empty forms to avoid semantic drift
